items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I think it was James P. Lowry.

ctx.x: That's the greatest trombone player -- I mean as far as technique is concerned -- I've never seen anybody like that you know. Read the stuff just like that you know and run all through it. They tell me he was with a circus band years ago. I think it was James P. Lowry. Have you ever heard of that?
